_readme: STARTING LIST ONLY. On first start these are copied into the bot's database. After that, manage announcements in Discord with /announcement (add, edit, remove, list) - edits to this file are ignored once the database has been seeded. In-game: ':log announce <keyword>'. type 'h' = hint bar, 'm' = full-screen message.

taxi.label: Taxi / Limo
taxi.message: 🚕 Private taxi service is now live across the city. Need a ride? Call for pickup!

bus.label: Bus
bus.message: 🚌 City buses are running on schedule. Head to the nearest stop and hop on!

gas.label: Gas Station
gas.message: ⛽ Fuel depot is open with competitive prices, car washes, and snacks available.

modshop.label: Mod Shop
modshop.message: 🛠 Performance garage is accepting vehicles. Repairs, tuning, and custom work ready.

dealership.label: Car Dealership
dealership.message: 🚗 Dealership lot is stocked and open. Browse new and used vehicles for sale.

tow.label: Towing Service
tow.message: 🛻 Towing service is active. Broken down or need a recovery? Call for immediate assistance.

dmv.label: DMV
dmv.message: 🚗 The DMV is open! Get your license or handle your vehicle paperwork today.

coffee.label: Coffee
coffee.message: ☕ Downtown coffee house is serving fresh brews, pastries, and light meals.

foodtruck.label: Food Truck
foodtruck.message: 🍔 Street food truck is parked and open. Grab burgers, fries, and cold drinks.

bakery.label: Bakery
bakery.message: 🍩 Bakery is fresh out of the oven. Donuts, cookies, cakes, and more available.

sushi.label: Sushi
sushi.message: 🍣 Sushi bar is accepting customers. Fresh rolls and specialty dishes ready.

barber.label: Barbershop
barber.message: 💈 Barber shop is open for cuts, fades, and beard work. Walk-ins welcome.

bank.label: Bank
bank.message: 🏦 Bank is open for deposits, withdrawals, and account services.

highrock.label: High Rock
highrock.message: 🌲 City park is open to the public. Enjoy the trails, picnic areas, and lake.

jewelry.label: Jewelry
jewelry.message: 💎 Jewelry boutique is displaying new collections. Rings, chains, and watches available.

hospital.label: Hospital
hospital.message: 🏥 The hospital is open. Stop by for treatment, check-ups, and medical care.

gunstore.label: Gun Store
gunstore.message: 🔫 The gun store is open! Feel free to check out the newest stock of weapons!

clothing.label: Clothing Shop
clothing.message: 👕 Clothing boutique just dropped new fits. Upgrade your wardrobe today.

cinema.label: Cinema
cinema.message: 🎥 Cinema is showing the latest films. Tickets and snacks available at the door.

records.label: Record Store
records.message: 💿 Record store is stocked with vinyl, CDs, and exclusive releases.

electronics.label: Electronics
electronics.message: 📱 Electronics shop is open. Phones, drones, and gadgets ready for purchase.

garbage.label: Garbage Truck
garbage.message: 🗑 Sanitation trucks are on route. Have your bins ready for pickup.

postal.label: Postal Services
postal.message: 📧 Postal service is delivering mail. Check your boxes for packages and letters.

policedesk.label: Police Desk
policedesk.message: 👮 Police desk is open for reports, complaints, and civilian inquiries.

courthouse.label: Courthouse
courthouse.message: 👨‍⚖️ Courthouse is in session. Attend hearings or legal proceedings as required.

ems.label: EMS
ems.message: 🚑 EMS units are on standby. Call emergency services if medical help is needed.

lafd.label: LAFD
lafd.message: 🚒 Fire department is staffed and ready to respond to any incidents.

construction.label: Construction
construction.message: 🏗 Construction site is active. Heavy equipment and workers on location.

hitman.label: Hitman
hitman.message: 🔪 Quiet contract services are currently available. Serious inquiries only.

security.label: Security
security.message: 🛡 Private security teams are taking protection jobs. Message for rates.

getaway.label: Driving
getaway.message: 🚓 Getaway drivers are online and ready. Fast extraction available on request.

deals.label: Secret Deals
deals.message: 🕶 Underground deals are happening tonight. Stay sharp and keep it discreet.

needpolice.label: Police Team
needpolice.message: 🚓 Police numbers are low. Consider switching to LEO to help balance the server.

needfire.label: LAFD Team
needfire.message: 🚒 Fire Department needs more active members. Join FD if you're available.

needdot.label: DOT Team
needdot.message: 🚚 DOT is short-staffed. Switch over and help keep the roads clear.

needciv.label: Civ Team
needciv.message: 🏎 Civilian population is low. Switch to Civ to keep roleplay flowing.

needems.label: EMS Team
needems.message: 🚑 EMS is understaffed. More medics needed for faster response times.

safezone.label: Safe Zone
safezone.message: ⚠ Safe zones are no-crime areas. No shooting or robberies at spawn or marked safe locations.

jurisdiction.label: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.message: 🚔 Stay within your assigned jurisdiction. Do not leave your designated area without reason.

avatars.label: Avatars
avatars.message: 👕 Only approved uniforms and outfits are allowed. Restricted clothing will result in a warning.

cuffrush.label: Cuff Rush
cuffrush.message: ⚠ Always use *cuffs before detaining. Skipping this step is a rule break.

crashes.label: RPing Crashes
crashes.message: 🚗 All crashes must be roleplayed unless clearly caused by lag or desync.

interrupt.label: RP Interruption
interrupt.message: ⚠ Do not interrupt ongoing scenes you were not originally part of.

speeding.label: Excessive Speed
speeding.message: 🚨 Excessive speed (100+ mph in city / 120+ on highway) is considered GTA driving.

assistance.label: Assistance
assistance.message: 🎗 Need staff assistance or want to report something? Type !mod in chat.

community.label: Community
community.message: 💬 Joining the community is required to play. Code is available in-game.

callvolume.label: Call Volume
callvolume.message: ❗ Call volume is high right now. Please be patient while we work through the queue.

reports.label: Reports
reports.message: 🔗 Staff abuse reports go through tickets in the community server only.

joinstaff.label: Join Staff Team
joinstaff.message: 📋 Looking to join the staff team? Applications are open in the community.
